author: Thant-Thuta
title: Good Music App
content: I like it. Works really well for Oflline Music Mp3 files. However the update that brought the logo to loading screen is a bit ugly. Love it before when there were no logos and it looked a bit more polished.

author: sunherd
title: Great! No syncing with iTunes!
content: Most other simple players have recently integrated with iTunes library. I really want these to be separate. I use Evermusic just to play files synced with Dropbox and it does that very well.
